title: Unfortunate Timing
text:
I want to start by saying that I don't regret pursuing the photoshoot, and the photographer was very nice. HOWEVER, our session did not start until 6:30pm (in November) at the suggestion of the photographer and it was so dark that he had to use a very bright flash for all the pictures. As a result, in most of the pictures we either look completely washed out, or the background is so dark as to be unrecognizable. 

We definitely ended up with a handful of great shots, so I don't regret the purchase, I would just warn others to check the timing of their photoshoots before booking.
author: PrincessLeia91
